verdict.rationale: Blaxel offers serverless hosting for remote MCP servers and also hosts agents, so MCP servers can be deployed alongside agents on the platform. The evidence describes hosting and serving MCP servers, not a client-side mechanism for Blaxel or its hosted agents to connect to arbitrary MCP servers and call their tools. missing for 10: explicit documentation of connecting external or hosted MCP servers to Blaxel agents as a tool source, configuration or SDK details for consuming MCP tools, independent or hands-on corroboration.
